links.comparator_used: Vendor built-in (off-the-shelf) DLAS model used as-is, without institutional retraining
links.outcome: Segmentation accuracy (Dice similarity coefficient) for prostate, seminal vesicles and rectum
links.effect: Retrained custom model mean DSC 0.82 prostate, 0.48 SV, 0.92 rectum vs built-in model 0.73, 0.37, 0.81; reported as a significant improvement
links.tradeoff: Custom model still had failures (91.3% acceptance and 8.7% consensus unacceptable vs 96.5% and 3.5% for manual contours); failure modes included cystogram, hip prosthesis, brachytherapy seeds, air in endorectal balloon, non-iodinated spacer, giant bladder. Retraining required 100 institutional patients.
links.quote: This represents a significant improvement over the built-in model with DSC of 0.73, 0.37, and 0.81 for the corresponding structures.

design_hint: local incremental retraining / fine-tuning with institutional data
